in_arabic.name: فهدى
in_arabic.meaning: حامل الفهد، فهد، ذو البدر، ذو القمر، ذو النجم
in_arabic.long_meaning: فهدى هو اسم عربي، من فهد، بمعنى حامل الفهد، أو ذو البدر، أو ذو القمر، أو ذو النجم. والفهد من الحيوانات التي تعتبر فاتحة في الإسلام، وسميت بهذا الأسم لأنه يفتح البدر في النوم، ويفتح البدر في النهار، ويفتح البدر في كل مكان.

in_urdu.name: فہدی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فہدی نام ایک عربي نام ہے، جو فہد سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے چاندنی، ستارہ، چاند، یا فاتح۔ اس نام کو مسلمانوں نے اپنایا ہے کیونکہ چاندنی اور ستاروں کو اسلام میں بھی بڑا مقام حاصل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़हर्द
in_hindi.meaning: चंद्रमा, चंद्र का प्रकाश, चंद्र निकेता, चंद्र सुत
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़हर्द एक अरबी नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है चंद्रमा, चंद्र का प्रकाश, चंद्र निकेता, या चंद्र सुत। यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है, क्योंकि चंद्रमा को हिंदू धर्म में भी बहुत महत्व दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فهدی
in_pashto.meaning: فهد، چنډني، ستاره، چنډ، فتح کون
in_pashto.long_meaning: فهدی دا نوم یو عربي نوم دی، چې فهد څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د چنډني، ستاره، چنډ، یا فتح کون په معنا لري. دا نوم مسلمانو لخوا غوره شوی دی، ځکه چې چنډني او ستارو ته اسلام کې هم ډیرو مقامونه لري.

in_english.name: Fahdi
in_english.meaning: holder of the falcon, falcon, moon, star, opener
in_english.long_meaning: Fahdi is an Arabic name derived from the root word falcon, meaning holder of the falcon, or opener. The falcon is considered a symbol of Islam, known for opening the way, and is an important name in Islamic tradition. It is also associated with the moon and star, symbolizing guidance and illumination.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fahdi carries a strong cultural impact within the Islamic community due to its roots in Arabic linguistics. The meaning of the name is closely associated with wisdom, intellectual prowess, and leadership, traits that are highly valued and revered within Islamic tradition. Fahdi is often used as a name for children, especially boys, with aspirations for a life of learning and guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Fahdi holds deep significance as it represents the embodiment of God's wisdom and guidance for humanity. It serves as a reminder that true leadership and intelligence come from a connection to the divine, and that those who seek wisdom and knowledge will be guided by the divine hand. The name Fahdi is a constant encouragement to strive for knowledge, understanding, and the betterment of oneself and those around them.

historical_references.reference: Fahd ibn Abd al-Malik was the fifth Umayyad caliph who ruled from 711 to 714 CE. He is best known for his military campaigns against the Berber rebels in North Africa and his significant expansion of the Umayyad empire.

Fahd bin Sultan was a prominent Saudi Arabian political figure who served as the Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia from 1982 to 1995. He played a significant role in the modernization and development of Saudi Arabia during his tenure as crown prince.
